style: factual clickbait for China finance audience

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一

briefs.speaker: Jiong Shao
briefs.current_title: 巴克莱邵炯：电商份额企稳，外卖亏损大降，阿里迎来甜蜜点
current_title_lines: 电商份额企稳，外卖亏损大降

subtitles.zh: 阿里一直有增长缓慢的传统电商业务，多年来市场份额持续流失。
subtitles.en: Adivabas has been, it has kind of a slow growing legacy e-commerce business. They've been losing market share for years.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为处于甜蜜点的原因是电商业务不再丢失份额，基本与行业同步增长。
subtitles.en: The reason we think that in a sweet spot is that the e-commerce business is no longer losing share. Then more or less growing line with the industry.

subtitles.zh: 利润率也保持稳定。
subtitles.en: And the profit margin has stable as well.

subtitles.zh: 此外，外卖业务的亏损正在快速收窄，从去年9月当季的360亿降至现在的100亿。
subtitles.en: And on top of that, the losses for the food delivery business is coming down very, very fast. It was 36 billion, some crazy number of backing September quarter last year. Now it's 10 billion.

subtitles.zh: 外卖业务亏损削减了70%到75%。
subtitles.en: So they cut the loss by 70-75% for the food delivery business.

subtitles.zh: 所以甜蜜点在于AI业务高速增长，而核心业务表现稳健。
subtitles.en: So the sweet spot put them where the growing AI business very, very fast, but the core business is doing okay.

briefs.speaker: Jiong Shao
briefs.current_title: 巴克莱邵炯：阿里腾讯谁是中国版Anthropic？路径不同回报各异

subtitles.zh: 节目早些时候提到Anthropic可能十月IPO，目标估值两万亿。
subtitles.en: Earlier on the program, you were talking about Enthropy IPO, coming up rumored around October. The challenge is that they're aiming for two trillion valuation.

subtitles.zh: 在Anthropic IPO之前，市场在思考谁是中国版Anthropic？我们认为领先候选是腾讯或阿里。
subtitles.en: So ahead of Enthropy IPO, people are thinking about who is the Chinese Enthropic? And in our view, it's either, well, at least the leading candidates are Tencent or Alibaba.

subtitles.zh: 他们做出了不同的战略选择。阿里因其为国内企业提供云服务的历史。
subtitles.en: They have made different strategic bets. Alibaba, because of its sort of history in providing cloud services to enterprises throughout China.

subtitles.zh: 所以他们自然成为算力领域的参与者，采购GPU/CPU并向客户提供服务。
subtitles.en: So that's very natural for them to be a player in the compute space, which is by a bunch of GPU CPUs and provide that services to your customers.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为腾讯押注不同的方向，专注于企业级AI代理领域。
subtitles.en: The Tencent we believe is making a different bet, depending on the enterprise AI aging space.

subtitles.zh: 这就是腾讯的企业AI代理Workbody成为中国领先的企业AI代理的原因。
subtitles.en: That's why Workbody, which is the AI agent for enterprises in China from Tencent, is a leading enterprise AI agent in China.

subtitles.zh: 回报特征也会不同。像阿里这样的基础设施玩家几乎立即获得回报，这就是三年回本的原因。
subtitles.en: Now, the return profiles will be a little bit different as well. If you're an infrastructure player like Baba, you will get a return almost immediately. That's why you're paying by time in three years.

subtitles.zh: 但企业AI代理的回报周期更长，然而我们预计其潜在市场规模会大得多。
subtitles.en: But the return profile for AI aging for enterprise is much longer, but we actually seeing the Ten-Eventure market size can be a lot bigger down the road.

briefs.speaker: Jiong Shao
briefs.current_title: 巴克莱邵炯：国际机会被低估，阿里云海外占比约10%

subtitles.zh: 说得好。我认为国际机会最被美国和欧洲市场低估。
subtitles.en: It's a great point. I think the international opportunity is the one that's most underappreciated by the investors in the US and possibly in Europe.

subtitles.zh: 但实际使用这些AI模型的用户已经认识到其价值，无论你是大型企业还是初创公司。
subtitles.en: But they are already appreciated by the actual users of these AI models, whether or not you are a large enterprises.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，许多美国大型企业正在使用阿里通义千问或其他中国开源模型，初创公司也在使用。
subtitles.en: You know, for a fact, many large US enterprises are using the Babas Queen model or other Chinese open source models, and startups are using these models as well.

subtitles.zh: 因为这些模型的成本仅为Anthropic或OpenAI模型的3%到5%。
subtitles.en: Because the cost for these models is what? 5%-3% of the anthropocardial open-air models.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们认为国际业务机会对阿里和腾讯都非常重要。
subtitles.en: So we see the international business opportunity should be very, very significant for both Ari Baba and for Tencent.

subtitles.zh: 对阿里而言，我们估计目前AI云业务中来自国际的占比不到10%，约10%。
subtitles.en: And for Baba, we estimate already less than 10%, or roughly 10% of the AI cloud business is coming from internationally.

subtitles.zh: 但中东、东南亚、欧洲对这些公司来说可能是非常大的市场。
subtitles.en: But Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe can be very, very sizable market for these companies.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们认为，随着时间推移，市场会越来越认可阿里、智谱AI、月之暗面、MiniMax等公司的价值。
subtitles.en: So we see over time, investors will increasingly appreciate the value, the Babas over the world, the Zida AI, the Moonshot, the Mini Max.

events.candidate_system_prompt:
You are a Chinese viral-title angle architect. Return strict JSON only. Do not write a safe summary. Generate competing, fact-grounded emotional angles for each clip. Each candidate must make a viewer feel one strong reaction instead of mild interest. Use the research guide as a hard boundary: unsupported surprise, dishonesty, holdings, public actions, and national comparisons are forbidden. Wording guard for all Chinese output:
- Do not use hard crisis/doom financial wording such as 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、流动性危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了、萧条、衰退.

- Never directly use 房价/房價/住房价格/住宅价格/房屋价格/楼市价格 in Chinese output. Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:

- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.

- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

briefs.speaker: Mary Ann Sung
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Strategy Officer at Fancy Group
briefs.current_title: Fancy集团首席战略官：营收增43%，API收入激增8倍
current_title_lines: AI需求爆发，增长势头强劲

subtitles.zh: 是的，我们昨晚发布了非常强劲的业绩。
subtitles.en: Yes, we delivered a very strong set of results late last night.

subtitles.zh: 如您所说，集团营收同比增长43%。
subtitles.en: As you mentioned, Group Revenue Group 43% year on year.

subtitles.zh: 同时，我们在净利润和调整后净利润方面也实现了重要里程碑。
subtitles.en: And we also delivered a significant milestone of both net profit and adjusted net profit.

subtitles.zh: 这巩固了我们顺应长期结构性趋势的增长。
subtitles.en: That have solidified our growth into the long-term structural trend.

subtitles.zh: 尤其想强调我们API业务的增长，这是自动凸轮业务。
subtitles.en: Particularly, I would like to highlight the growth in our API, which is auto-convexory.

subtitles.zh: 该业务营收增长了超过8倍。
subtitles.en: We saw our revenue grew more than eight times.

subtitles.zh: 同时，Token需求同比激增近6倍甚至更多，相比去年上半年。
subtitles.en: And also token demand surged close to six times or more year on year compared to first half last year.

briefs.speaker: Mary Ann Sung
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Strategy Officer at Fancy Group
briefs.current_title: Fancy集团首席战略官：中立开放平台，与竞争对手共赢
current_title_lines: 中立开放平台，与竞争对手共赢

subtitles.zh: 这个问题问得很好。
subtitles.en: It is a very well asked question.

subtitles.zh: 我们经常被问到这个问题。
subtitles.en: We've been asked this question repeatedly.

subtitles.zh: 自成立以来，我们致力于成为中立、开源的平台。
subtitles.en: Since the founding of our time, we committed to be neutral open source platform.

subtitles.zh: 我们与老牌模型公司和算力公司都有合作。
subtitles.en: We worked with old model companies and we worked with old compute companies.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们的虚拟GPU现在能够为企业客户提供超过20万个模型。
subtitles.en: And hence, with that, now our virtual GPU is able to provide more than 200,000 of models for our enterprise customers.

subtitles.zh: 您提到的许多市场竞争对手，实际上是我们长期信赖的合作伙伴，他们也是我们的付费客户。
subtitles.en: So many of those, what you mentioned about competitors in the marketplace are actually very good long-term trusted partners of ours that we also service as paying customers.

briefs.speaker: Mary Ann Sung
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Strategy Officer at Fancy Group
briefs.current_title: Fancy集团首席战略官：AI需求将持续多年高增长
current_title_lines: AI需求将持续多年高增长

subtitles.zh: 从结构性趋势来看，我们做了大量深入分析。
subtitles.en: If we look at structural trend, we have done quite a bit of analysis on dive through.

subtitles.zh: 我们参考了第三方数据和全球数据。
subtitles.en: We look at older third party data, we look at global numbers.

subtitles.zh: 从需求端来看，我们看到了显著强劲的增长需求。
subtitles.en: Structurally, we see significant strong growth demand from a demand side of the equation.

subtitles.zh: 未来几年，尤其是到2030年，我们相信需求增长可能会翻数倍。
subtitles.en: For the next few years, particularly going into 2030, we believe that the growth demand will likely to be multiple folds.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们预计今年下半年将比上半年实现更高的增长。
subtitles.en: And hence, we are seeing the second half of this year, likely to deliver even higher growth versus first half.

subtitles.zh: 这种增长可能会持续未来几年，主要由全球AI发展和创新的需求驱动，更重要的是AI的大规模部署。
subtitles.en: And that's likely to continue for the next three years, a few years, mostly driven by a global demand of AI development, AI innovation, and more importantly is the AI deployment into scale.

briefs.speaker: Mary Ann Sung
briefs.speaker_context: Chief Strategy Officer at Fancy Group
briefs.current_title: Fancy集团首席战略官：中国AI平台盈利前景可期
current_title_lines: 中国AI平台盈利前景可期

subtitles.zh: 我想从几个方面来回答。
subtitles.en: I think I'll answer this in a couple of ways.

subtitles.zh: 首先，市场对此非常了解。
subtitles.en: One, it's very well understood by the market.

subtitles.zh: 中国拥有高效、成本效益高的开源模型。
subtitles.en: China has highly effective cost-effective open source models.

subtitles.zh: 这些模型易于部署，灵活性强。
subtitles.en: That's easy to deploy, that's flexible.

subtitles.zh: 中国拥有大量廉价、高效、稳定的电力供应，这也是AI部署的重要基础。
subtitles.en: And China has a very large amount of cheap, effective, and efficient power supplies, which is also not a very important component for AI deployment.

subtitles.zh: 至少对于Fancy集团，看看我们的付费客户。
subtitles.en: At least for Fancy, you look at our paying customers.

subtitles.zh: 付费客户数量同比增长超过5倍。
subtitles.en: The number of amount of paying customers year on year compared to the same period last year has grown more than five votes.

subtitles.zh: 这些客户都来自大型企业。
subtitles.en: All those are from large enterprises.

subtitles.zh: 他们迫切寻求更高效、可扩展的AI解决方案，我们尚未看到需求放缓。
subtitles.en: Those are eagerly looking for more effective, scalable AI solutions, and we are not yet seeing a slow demand in that.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

Writing rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.
- Ideal line lengths are 3-10, 4-12, and 5-14 Chinese characters. Full title is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- The title must reveal enough familiar context to create a small information gap, then withhold the explanation supplied by the video.
- Prefer concrete verbs and consequences: 逼急、藏不住、说透、砍半. Use only when facts support them. "改口" requires research.position_change.supported with two independent sources; words-versus-actions phrases require research.words_vs_actions.supported with two independent sources.
- Do not mechanically copy examples or proper nouns from instructions. Derive every noun, number, actor, and comparison from this clip and its evidence card.
- angle_id, emotion_pole, and viewer_reaction are private editorial metadata. Never copy their wording into title or title_lines.
- Final cover structure should be [specific subject] / [unexpected fact or comparison] / [concrete unresolved consequence], not [speaker category] / [editorial label] / [topic].
- If a person or institution is genuinely recognizable, use its verified proper name. If it is not recognizable, omit the identity and lead with the subject and fact; do not replace it with generic labels such as 外资策略师 or 海外专家.
- For names and technical terms, use only the current clip's verified title_label. Never use official_zh/legal company names as cover copy, and never invent a Chinese transliteration when title_label is empty or English.

- For China-related clips, never attack China or imply national decline. Favor confidence, competence, policy room, industrial strength, cost advantage, talent, resilience, and competitors being forced to respond.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.

4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

Title and display rules:
- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Use exactly three non-empty title lines, each a punchy cover block. Ideal lengths: 3-10, 4-12, 5-14 Chinese characters.
- Full title should be short and sharp, ideally 10-24 Chinese characters.
- Keep only one core conflict. Do not pack background, claim, caveat, and conclusion into one line.
- Highlights must be exact substrings of joined title_lines and emphasize the actor, number, reversal, China advantage, or tension.
- Do not use flat endings such as 回报路径在哪、回报存疑、前景如何、未来如何、有待观察、仍不明朗、面临挑战、带来机遇、释放信号、关键分叉在哪、有望扩大. Turn the caveat into a concrete unresolved action or contradiction.
- Every line must be a complete Chinese phrase. Do not leave a transitive tension verb such as 逼急、逼到、迫使 or 倒逼 without its subject or object.
- Do not use source badges, emojis, markdown, quotation marks, hashtags, or numbering.
- Title fields must not contain 资产管理、投资、股票、基金、理财、保险、投顾、荐股、买入、卖出.
- Never use 经济危机、金融危机、债务危机、危机、崩盘、崩溃、完了、没救、惨了.
- Do not mention sensitive geopolitical or military topics.

KC comment rules:
- comment starts with KC评论： and adds context, consequence, or the next fact to watch in 16-34 Chinese characters. Do not repeat the title.
- subtitle_comments contains one item for every input subtitle index, grounded in that exact subtitle rather than a generic clip slogan.
- Each subtitle comment starts with KC评论： and is ideally 10-24 Chinese characters after the prefix, with a complete ending.
- Adjacent subtitle comments must vary between evidence, implication, tension, consequence, and context.
- All highlight strings must be exact substrings of their corresponding title/comment.

Operating rule: 二极管法则
- A candidate is usable only if one emotion pole is unmistakable and emotion_tension is at least 8/10.
- The six permitted poles are: unexpected reversal, pleasant surprise, strong doubt, finally-someone-said-it candor, verified words-versus-actions contrast, and fact-based pride in a Chinese comparative advantage.
- Do not split the emotion across several mild ideas. Pick one pole and push it to the factual limit.
- A question mark is not emotion. "前景如何", "回报路径在哪", "能否实现", "面临哪些挑战", "回报存疑", and "释放什么信号" score at most 4 unless they contain a concrete contradiction or consequence.

Angle rules:
- surprise_reversal: state the familiar baseline, then expose the source claim that reverses it. Do not turn a baseline contrast into "改口" unless research.position_change.supported is true with at least two independent sources.
- outsider_candor: use only when a foreign institution/expert says something unusually direct. Keep the identity contrast in evidence_basis and viewer_reaction, then realize it in final copy by placing the specific surprising claim against its consequence. Never literally output 外资策略师、外资首席、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话, or 西方机构承认.
- words_vs_actions: use only when research.words_vs_actions.supported is true and independent_source_count is at least 2. Show the two exact sides in question form. Never directly call anyone a liar.
- china_advantage: use only when research.china_advantage.supported is true. Put the concrete Chinese advantage or the foreign competitor's forced response in the foreground. The emotional direction must favor China.
- authority_breaks_consensus: the authority must be recognizable to a China audience, or be labeled by a meaningful role. Do not lead with an obscure romanized name.
- concrete_stakes: expose a specific number, forced choice, consequence, or who gains/loses. Generic importance is not a stake.

- Style: factual clickbait for China finance audience
- Produce exactly four candidates per clip and use at least three different angle_id values when the evidence permits.
- Each candidate has exactly three short title lines. Think cover blocks, not a newspaper sentence.

Tournament procedure, perform in this order:
1. Evidence veto: reject candidates that use a name, number, consensus, public action, comparison, or accusation not supported by that clip's transcript/research card.
2. China direction veto: for China-related clips, reject any candidate whose emotional target is China, Chinese people, Chinese companies, or China's future. Comparative pride is allowed only when supported.
3. Neutrality veto: reject flat summaries and generic questions. A question mark alone does not create tension.
4. Meta-copy veto: reject titles that expose the editor's reasoning with labels such as 外资策略师、外资首席、海外专家、西方策略师、罕见直言、外媒点破、终于有人说、只有外资敢说、大实话、 or 西方机构承认. The viewer should feel the effect from the facts, not be told how to feel.
5. Audience test: complete exactly one sentence: "看完标题，观众第一反应是____". If the answer is merely "我知道发生了什么", reject it.
6. Score survivors from 0-10. Final requires emotion_tension >= 8, novelty >= 7, specificity >= 7, curiosity_gap >= 7, factual_fidelity >= 9. For China clips, china_resonance >= 8.
7. Select the winner or combine only two candidates. If no candidate passes, write one new title, then score it honestly.
8. Before returning, verify every quality_check field. If any is false, rewrite once. Never return a known failure.

Editorial interpretation:
- 二极管 means one high-activation pole, not random anger: 意外, 惊喜, 强疑惑, 终于有人说, 有证据的言行反差, or 民族自豪.
- 新鲜感 requires a baseline plus a reversal. "外资谈中国" is ordinary; "外资在普遍悲观时罕见给出积极判断" is a usable reversal only if public_baseline supports it.
- 大实话 comes from who said what and why that identity makes the candor surprising. Do not paste "大实话" onto a routine forecast.
- 大实话、终于有人说、反差质疑 and 民族自豪 describe the intended viewer response internally. Do not print those labels or their editorial scaffolding in the title. Express them through the specific fact, comparison, and consequence.
- The desired effect of a possible falsehood angle is factual suspicion, not a verdict. Only when words_vs_actions is verified may you use a question such as "嘴上X，手里却Y？".
- "改口" means the same actor demonstrably held a different prior position. It requires research.position_change.supported and at least two independent sources. Never infer a change from search-result absence, lack of prior coverage, or a vague reputation.
- 民族自豪 comes from a concrete comparison: cost, technology, talent, supply chain, demand, speed, resilience, or a foreign competitor's forced adjustment. Do not use empty slogans.
- Familiar authority helps. Use a verified proper name only when the audience is likely to recognize it. Otherwise lead with the concrete subject; generic editorial identities such as 外资策略师、海外专家 or 西方策略师 are not final copy.
- Bloomberg/Bloomberg LP/彭博社 is normally the source, never the guest. Do not output 彭博有限合伙企业.
- Use only verified title_label values from this clip's entity/term card. Do not expand a familiar short name into a formal full name, and do not borrow an entity from another clip.

briefs.speaker: Jiong Shao
briefs.current_title: 巴克莱邵炯：阿里腾讯谁是中国版Anthropic？路径不同回报各异

subtitles.zh: 节目早些时候提到Anthropic可能十月IPO，目标估值两万亿。
subtitles.en: Earlier on the program, you were talking about Enthropy IPO, coming up rumored around October. The challenge is that they're aiming for two trillion valuation.

subtitles.zh: 在Anthropic IPO之前，市场在思考谁是中国版Anthropic？我们认为领先候选是腾讯或阿里。
subtitles.en: So ahead of Enthropy IPO, people are thinking about who is the Chinese Enthropic? And in our view, it's either, well, at least the leading candidates are Tencent or Alibaba.

subtitles.zh: 他们做出了不同的战略选择。阿里因其为国内企业提供云服务的历史。
subtitles.en: They have made different strategic bets. Alibaba, because of its sort of history in providing cloud services to enterprises throughout China.

subtitles.zh: 所以他们自然成为算力领域的参与者，采购GPU/CPU并向客户提供服务。
subtitles.en: So that's very natural for them to be a player in the compute space, which is by a bunch of GPU CPUs and provide that services to your customers.

subtitles.zh: 我们认为腾讯押注不同的方向，专注于企业级AI代理领域。
subtitles.en: The Tencent we believe is making a different bet, depending on the enterprise AI aging space.

subtitles.zh: 这就是腾讯的企业AI代理Workbody成为中国领先的企业AI代理的原因。
subtitles.en: That's why Workbody, which is the AI agent for enterprises in China from Tencent, is a leading enterprise AI agent in China.

subtitles.zh: 回报特征也会不同。像阿里这样的基础设施玩家几乎立即获得回报，这就是三年回本的原因。
subtitles.en: Now, the return profiles will be a little bit different as well. If you're an infrastructure player like Baba, you will get a return almost immediately. That's why you're paying by time in three years.

subtitles.zh: 但企业AI代理的回报周期更长，然而我们预计其潜在市场规模会大得多。
subtitles.en: But the return profile for AI aging for enterprise is much longer, but we actually seeing the Ten-Eventure market size can be a lot bigger down the road.

briefs.current_title: 巴克莱邵炯：国际机会被低估，阿里云海外占比约10%

subtitles.zh: 说得好。我认为国际机会最被美国和欧洲市场低估。
subtitles.en: It's a great point. I think the international opportunity is the one that's most underappreciated by the investors in the US and possibly in Europe.

subtitles.zh: 但实际使用这些AI模型的用户已经认识到其价值，无论你是大型企业还是初创公司。
subtitles.en: But they are already appreciated by the actual users of these AI models, whether or not you are a large enterprises.

subtitles.zh: 事实上，许多美国大型企业正在使用阿里通义千问或其他中国开源模型，初创公司也在使用。
subtitles.en: You know, for a fact, many large US enterprises are using the Babas Queen model or other Chinese open source models, and startups are using these models as well.

subtitles.zh: 因为这些模型的成本仅为Anthropic或OpenAI模型的3%到5%。
subtitles.en: Because the cost for these models is what? 5%-3% of the anthropocardial open-air models.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们认为国际业务机会对阿里和腾讯都非常重要。
subtitles.en: So we see the international business opportunity should be very, very significant for both Ari Baba and for Tencent.

subtitles.zh: 对阿里而言，我们估计目前AI云业务中来自国际的占比不到10%，约10%。
subtitles.en: And for Baba, we estimate already less than 10%, or roughly 10% of the AI cloud business is coming from internationally.

subtitles.zh: 但中东、东南亚、欧洲对这些公司来说可能是非常大的市场。
subtitles.en: But Middle East, Southeast Asia, Europe can be very, very sizable market for these companies.

subtitles.zh: 因此我们认为，随着时间推移，市场会越来越认可阿里、智谱AI、月之暗面、MiniMax等公司的价值。
subtitles.en: So we see over time, investors will increasingly appreciate the value, the Babas over the world, the Zida AI, the Moonshot, the Mini Max.

subtitles.zh: 这个问题问得很好。
subtitles.en: It is a very well asked question.

subtitles.zh: 我们经常被问到这个问题。
subtitles.en: We've been asked this question repeatedly.

subtitles.zh: 自成立以来，我们致力于成为中立、开源的平台。
subtitles.en: Since the founding of our time, we committed to be neutral open source platform.

subtitles.zh: 我们与老牌模型公司和算力公司都有合作。
subtitles.en: We worked with old model companies and we worked with old compute companies.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们的虚拟GPU现在能够为企业客户提供超过20万个模型。
subtitles.en: And hence, with that, now our virtual GPU is able to provide more than 200,000 of models for our enterprise customers.

subtitles.zh: 您提到的许多市场竞争对手，实际上是我们长期信赖的合作伙伴，他们也是我们的付费客户。
subtitles.en: So many of those, what you mentioned about competitors in the marketplace are actually very good long-term trusted partners of ours that we also service as paying customers.

current_title_lines: AI需求将持续多年高增长

subtitles.zh: 从结构性趋势来看，我们做了大量深入分析。
subtitles.en: If we look at structural trend, we have done quite a bit of analysis on dive through.

subtitles.zh: 我们参考了第三方数据和全球数据。
subtitles.en: We look at older third party data, we look at global numbers.

subtitles.zh: 从需求端来看，我们看到了显著强劲的增长需求。
subtitles.en: Structurally, we see significant strong growth demand from a demand side of the equation.

subtitles.zh: 未来几年，尤其是到2030年，我们相信需求增长可能会翻数倍。
subtitles.en: For the next few years, particularly going into 2030, we believe that the growth demand will likely to be multiple folds.

subtitles.zh: 因此，我们预计今年下半年将比上半年实现更高的增长。
subtitles.en: And hence, we are seeing the second half of this year, likely to deliver even higher growth versus first half.

subtitles.zh: 这种增长可能会持续未来几年，主要由全球AI发展和创新的需求驱动，更重要的是AI的大规模部署。
subtitles.en: And that's likely to continue for the next three years, a few years, mostly driven by a global demand of AI development, AI innovation, and more importantly is the AI deployment into scale.

current_title_lines: 中国AI平台盈利前景可期

subtitles.zh: 我想从几个方面来回答。
subtitles.en: I think I'll answer this in a couple of ways.

subtitles.zh: 首先，市场对此非常了解。
subtitles.en: One, it's very well understood by the market.

subtitles.zh: 中国拥有高效、成本效益高的开源模型。
subtitles.en: China has highly effective cost-effective open source models.

subtitles.zh: 这些模型易于部署，灵活性强。
subtitles.en: That's easy to deploy, that's flexible.

subtitles.zh: 中国拥有大量廉价、高效、稳定的电力供应，这也是AI部署的重要基础。
subtitles.en: And China has a very large amount of cheap, effective, and efficient power supplies, which is also not a very important component for AI deployment.

subtitles.zh: 至少对于Fancy集团，看看我们的付费客户。
subtitles.en: At least for Fancy, you look at our paying customers.

subtitles.zh: 付费客户数量同比增长超过5倍。
subtitles.en: The number of amount of paying customers year on year compared to the same period last year has grown more than five votes.

subtitles.zh: 这些客户都来自大型企业。
subtitles.en: All those are from large enterprises.

subtitles.zh: 他们迫切寻求更高效、可扩展的AI解决方案，我们尚未看到需求放缓。
subtitles.en: Those are eagerly looking for more effective, scalable AI solutions, and we are not yet seeing a slow demand in that.

briefs.speaker: Andrew Fong
briefs.current_title: 恒地CFO：中环写字楼出租率95%，其他区域仍承压

subtitles.zh: 我想谈谈写字楼和商业地产。你认为我们处于复苏的哪个阶段？
subtitles.en: I want to talk about offices and commercial. Where do you think we are in the recovery?

subtitles.zh: 中环表现不错。
subtitles.en: Central is doing well.

subtitles.zh: 如你所知，Henderson的出租率已达95%。
subtitles.en: As you know, the Henderson is now 95% list out.

subtitles.zh: 中环项目有一点小问题。
subtitles.en: And we have a little problem for the central yard.

subtitles.zh: 小问题，非常小的问题。
subtitles.en: A little problem. We have very little problem. A very little problem.

subtitles.zh: 因为一家公司就占了至少75%的面积。
subtitles.en: Yeah, because one single company has at least 75% of the time.

subtitles.zh: 所以一期其实只有约7万平方英尺待租。
subtitles.en: So actually, there's only around 70,000 square feet to land out for the phase one.

subtitles.zh: 一期将在今年年底交付，希望年中左右开业。
subtitles.en: So the phase one will be delivered by the end of this year and to be open, hopefully around mid-year.

subtitles.zh: 中环表现相当好，入住率很高。
subtitles.en: So the central is doing quite well, as you see, the occupancy is high.

subtitles.zh: 整体租金有轻微上调，不只是我们。
subtitles.en: And there's a little bit of upside adjustment for rental as a whole, not just us.

subtitles.zh: 但总体而言，其他区域仍面临挑战。
subtitles.en: But overall, the other areas are still challenging.

subtitles.zh: 中环就是中环，高端就是高端。
subtitles.en: The central is the central. The high end is the high end.

subtitles.zh: 但其他区域进展甚微。
subtitles.en: But we see little progress in other areas.

subtitles.zh: 当然，学生公寓对部分外围区域有帮助。
subtitles.en: But of course, the student hostel helps some of the outside areas.

briefs.current_title: 恒地CFO：学生公寓实验成功，但改造成本高

subtitles.zh: 比如东九龙或西九龙，目前都受惠于学生公寓。
subtitles.en: Like East Cologne or the Far West Cologne is helped by the student hostel favor at the moment.

subtitles.zh: 能谈谈这个吗？学生潮有多快？
subtitles.en: Can you ask about that? How quickly is the student boom?

subtitles.zh: 提升了房地产的形象。
subtitles.en: Boosting the profile of the real estate.

subtitles.zh: 关于学生涌入的报道和讨论很多。
subtitles.en: Lots has been written and talked about when it comes to the influx of students.

subtitles.zh: 这是你想利用的机会吗？你怎么看？
subtitles.en: Is that something that you want to leverage on? How are you looking at this?

subtitles.zh: 去年我们在一个项目上做了实验。
subtitles.en: We do have one experiment in typo last year.

subtitles.zh: 效果相当满意，但从工业改造成学生公寓成本仍然很高。
subtitles.en: I think it's quite satisfactory, but conversion into commercial or from industrial to student hostel is still quite costly.

subtitles.zh: 所以情况各异。我们也没有太多楼宇可以改造成学生公寓。
subtitles.en: So it really varies. We do not have a lot of buildings available for changing into student hostels anyway.

subtitles.zh: 住宅方面我们已有布局，所以不太考虑这个。
subtitles.en: And the residential we wife, so we do not really look at that.

subtitles.zh: 但我认为这有助于银行出售一些重组资产。
subtitles.en: But I think it helps the banks to sell some of the restructure assets.

subtitles.zh: 我认为这是好事，整体上重组资产可以被释放。
subtitles.en: I think it's good. As a whole, because we structure assets can be released.
